title: WCAG 2.2 text contrast ratios at AA and AAA
statement:
WCAG 2.2 requires ordinary text to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio, with 3:1 allowed for large text at Level AA and 7:1 required at Level AAA, so teams can choose higher contrast when visual comfort and robustness justify it.

Options:
- WCAG AA normal text: 4.5:1 (fits: balanced, professional)
- WCAG AA large text: 3:1 (fits: expressive, display)
- WCAG AAA: 7:1 (fits: access-first, high legibility)
- Extra margin: 10:1 (fits: high legibility, utilitarian)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, ecommerce, education. Audience: adults, seniors, children under 10, general.
